Battleship Texas

The Houston-based rogue operations site and final major location of Compromised.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-27

Houston rogue site

Battleship Texas is not presented as a passive landmark in the novel. It is the operating hub of the rogue cell and the location of its stored viral payloads. [1]

  2. confirmed
